title: What manual work costs.
summary: Operational benchmarks we use to size a workflow before an assessment. Each is a median or an average from a named study, with the comparison group stated.

body.p: Cost to process one invoice: average organization vs top performers. Top performers also post in 3.1 days instead of 10.9 and see 9% exceptions instead of 22%.[^17]
At 50,000 invoices a year, the gap is about $400,000 and seven calendar days of float on every payable.
Share of finance teams whose month-end close runs six or more business days. 27% regularly take more than seven.[^18]
Every extra close day is a day leadership decides on last month's numbers, and a week of senior finance time spent assembling rather than analyzing.
Error rate for trained staff entering data by hand, measured per field in a controlled study.[^19]
On a 40-field record, that is an error in roughly half of all records. Each one is found downstream, by a customer, an auditor or a colleague who has to chase it.
Median cost per contact on assisted channels (phone, chat, email) vs self-service.[^20]
Most tier-1 requests are lookups against systems you already own. Each one that reaches an agent costs seven times what it needs to.
